controls.name: enable-repoints-routine-mapping
controls.description: enable -map overwrites an existing %IPM.* routine mapping instead of creating one only when absent

controls.name: repo-loop-ignores-rows
controls.description: the -repos loop maps a namespace that has registry rows of its own (NSP-B24 check dropped)

controls.name: enable-no-batch-activation
controls.description: enable -map never activates the new mappings (PerformBatchActivation dropped)

controls.name: unmap-keeps-package-mapping
controls.description: unmap does not remove the %IPM package mapping

controls.name: unmap-keeps-repo-mapping
controls.description: unmap does not remove the repo settings mapping

controls.name: installer-no-record
controls.description: the installer does not create the zpm record

controls.name: installer-no-activation
controls.description: the installer's mappings are not activated

controls.name: install-zpm-no-guard
controls.description: install zpm runs in a namespace GetMapInfo lists (CheckModuleNamespace dropped)

controls.name: version-read-none
controls.description: CheckIPMVersion never finds a version

controls.name: community-no-reset
controls.description: enable -community skips repo -reset-defaults

controls.name: no-premise-src
controls.description: drop premise SRC

controls.name: no-premise-uniq
controls.description: drop premise UNIQ

controls.name: no-premise-tgt
controls.description: drop premise TGT (mapping clause)

controls.name: no-premise-repos
controls.description: drop defect premise REPOS (F-NSP-4)

controls.name: no-premise-info
controls.description: drop premise INFO

controls.name: no-premise-rtn
controls.description: drop defect premise RTN (F-NSP-6)

controls.name: no-premise-inst
controls.description: drop defect premise INST (F-NSP-5)

controls.name: no-premise-own
controls.description: drop defect premise OWN (F-NSP-2)

controls.name: l1-enable-no-repo-sharing
controls.description: vacuity: L1 enable without the -repos sharing rule must lose the F-NSP-4 witness

controls.name: l1-install-keeps-code
controls.description: vacuity: L1 independence that keeps the mapped code must lose the F-NSP-5 witness

controls.name: l1-unmap-keeps-code
controls.description: vacuity: L1 unmap that keeps the code must lose the F-NSP-6 witness

controls.name: l1-version-local-record
controls.description: vacuity: L1 version read from the namespace's own record must lose the F-NSP-2 witness

controls.name: l1-enable-share-new-only
controls.description: vacuity: L1 -repos sharing only for newly mapped targets must lose the tie witness (F-NSP-7)
